edit_summary.reason: The policy farms repeatable bonuses (controlled_descent_bonus, touchdown_stability_bonus) without approaching the pad. This revision adds a strong lateral drift penalty to encourage centering over the pad, increases the distance penalty scale to provide a stronger gradient, and makes the touchdown_stability_bonus one-shot to prevent farming off-pad. The controlled_descent_bonus is kept repeatable but with a moderate distance condition (0.3) to encourage engine use during descent. The progress shaping distance penalty is increased from -0.05 to -0.1 to provide a stronger gradient. A lateral drift penalty (-0.05 * vx^2) is added to discourage lateral movement near the ground, which should help the lander stay centered over the pad during descent.
preserved_design: fuel_penalty (small -0.01 per main engine use) kept as mild deterrent
controlled_descent_bonus (repeatable, conditioned on distance and angle) but with moderate distance condition
changed_design: Increase progress_shaping distance penalty scale from -0.05 to -0.1 to provide a stronger gradient toward the pad.
Add lateral_drift_penalty: -0.05 * vx^2 to discourage lateral movement, especially near the ground. This encourages the lander to center over the pad during descent.

Make touchdown_stability_bonus one-shot: use a self attribute (self._touchdown_stability_collected) to track if it has been collected this episode. Reset at the start of each episode via hasattr check. This prevents farming the bonus by maintaining leg contact off-pad.
Keep controlled_descent_bonus repeatable but with a moderate distance condition (distance_to_pad < 0.3) to encourage engine use during descent without being too tight.
rejected_patterns_avoided: Do not make all bonuses one-shot (failed pattern from iter_002): only the touchdown_stability_bonus is made one-shot because it was the main source of farming.
Do not tighten conditions too aggressively (failed pattern from iter_003): the controlled_descent_bonus condition is set to 0.3 (moderate), not 0.1.
Do not simply increase raw main-engine/action bonuses: we add a lateral drift penalty and increase distance penalty instead.
Do not only reduce distance shaping: we add a new lateral drift penalty.
edit_summary.action_coverage_plan: All actions already used. The lateral drift penalty will encourage more use of orientation engines (actions 1 and 3) to correct lateral drift, potentially increasing their usage from ~15% to ~20%. The increased distance penalty will encourage more main engine use (action 2) to descend faster toward the pad.
edit_summary.phase_guidance_plan: Phase 1 (approach): increased distance penalty provides a stronger gradient to move toward the pad. Phase 2 (descent): controlled_descent_bonus (repeatable, distance<0.3) rewards using main engine when near pad and upright. Lateral drift penalty discourages drifting away from the pad. Phase 3 (touchdown): touchdown_stability_bonus (one-shot) rewards low velocity at contact. Success bonus provides final sparse signal.
edit_summary.payment_mode_plan: controlled_descent_bonus is per-step conditioned on being within moderate distance (0.3) and upright, so it encourages engine use during descent but cannot be farmed at a distance. touchdown_stability_bonus is one-shot event-gated (collect once per episode) to prevent farming off-pad. objective_success_bonus is one-shot event-gated. All other terms are per-step penalties.
